text: Cambodia's official rice seed system (ថ្នាក់ចំណាត់ថ្នាក់គ្រាប់ពូជ) has five grades, each one multiplied from the grade above it. Breeder seed (ពូជសុទ្ធជម្រើសវិទ្យា / Breeder seed) is the original true-to-type seed produced only by plant breeders; it is used to grow Foundation seed. Foundation seed (ពូជសុទ្ធគ្រឹះ / Foundation seed) is also produced by breeders, and is used to grow Registered seed. Registered seed (ពូជសុទ្ធទទួលស្គាល់ / Registered seed) is grown by trained technical staff at seed multiplication stations, and is used to grow Certified seed. Certified seed (ពូជសុទ្ធអនុញ្ញាត / Certified seed) is also grown by technical staff at stations, and is used to grow Good/commercial seed. Good seed, also called commercial seed (ពូជសុទ្ធល្អ / Good seed, commercial seed), is the final grade grown by technical staff, seed companies, or trained farmers in their communities for sale or distribution to other farmers for regular crop production. Farmers producing seed for sale to their neighbors are usually working at this final 'Good seed' level, multiplying from Certified seed they purchased from a station or company.
